hero.title: Fair project assignment for your school.
hero.lede: Wunschplatz imports your students’ project wishes and helps assign them fairly – right in the browser, with no Wunschplatz account. No paper chaos, no spreadsheet formulas.
hero.ctaHint: Free · No account needed · Open source

how.title: How it works
how.step1Text: Ready-made template for Google Forms or Microsoft Forms.
how.step2Text: Upload the CSV – columns are detected.
how.step3Text: Fair assignment, adjust, export to Excel.
how.hint: Pick a step for a look inside the app
how.caption: Excerpts from the app with sample data.

facts.title: Good to know
facts.roundsText: Multiple assignment rounds per year, each with its own result.
facts.note: Responses collected with Google Forms or Microsoft Forms are subject to that provider’s storage and privacy settings.
